packages.name: FusionSolar OpenAPI
packages.description: Huawei FusionSolar Northbound OpenAPI (cloud) driver: plant and inverter power and energy for Hubitat.

packages.name: Goldshell BYTE Miner
packages.description: Local driver for the Goldshell BYTE miner (MCB + CGMiner API): status, per-card metrics as child devices, LED/idle/power-plan control.

packages.name: Zemismart SDM02T Energy Meter
packages.description: Zigbee driver for the Zemismart SDM02T 2-phase energy meter (Tuya), built from DP sniffing: per-phase voltage, current, power and energy.

packages.name: FoxESS Cloud OpenAPI
packages.description: FoxESS Cloud OpenAPI driver for FoxESS (and WEG) inverters: real-time power, grid state and daily energy.

packages.name: Tholz SmartHeat
packages.description: Local TCP driver for the Tholz SmartHeat 2nd gen solar water-heater controller: temperatures, heat modes, setpoint, channel control and per-channel energy estimates.

packages.name: Tuya Zigbee Water Level Sensor
packages.description: Zigbee driver for the Tuya ultrasonic water-tank level sensor (_TZE200_lvkk0hdg): level, distance, water column height.

packages.name: Remotec ZXT-120 IR Extender
packages.description: Modified Z-Wave driver for the Remotec ZXT-120 IR extender, used to control air conditioners.

packages.name: GiEX Irrigation Valve (sh1btabb)
packages.description: Dedicated Zigbee driver for the GiEX irrigation valve _TZE200_sh1btabb: irrigation timing, water consumed and running totals. Based on kkossev's Tuya Zigbee Valve.

packages.name: Aeon Smart Dimmer 2nd Edition
packages.description: Z-Wave driver for the Aeon Labs Smart Dimmer 2nd Edition (DSC25), ported from SmartThings' metering dimmer.

packages.name: Aeon Multisensor Gen5
packages.description: Fixed Z-Wave driver for the Aeon Multisensor Gen5 (motion, temperature, humidity, illuminance, battery).

packages.name: Heiman HS2WD-E Siren
packages.description: Zigbee driver for the Heiman HS2WD-E siren: alarm, strobe and tone control.

packages.name: Hikvision Audible Alarm Trigger (ISAPI)
packages.description: Triggers the built-in audible alarm (siren/voice) on Hikvision cameras over ISAPI, locally.

packages.name: Roomba (Rest980)
packages.description: Standalone Roomba driver that talks to a local Rest980 server, with no parent app. Concepts from Aaron Ward's Roomba integration.

packages.name: Tuya IoT Platform (Cloud)
packages.description: Tuya IoT Platform cloud parent driver (based on Jonathan Bradshaw's), with ROPO and towel-warmer-safe patches.
